subject: Spark Accelerator — credit activation & qualification
messages:
From: Samir Gupta <samir@seedvault.io>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Jane Morales <jane@seedvault.io>
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 13:20:00 -0800
Subject: Spark accelerator — request for cohort credits

Hi Stephanie,

Hope you9are well. SeedVault runs the Spark accelerator (running cohorts quarterly) and we9re putting together the resources for our next cohort (Jan 2026). We9ve been piloting Redwood with two portfolio companies and the feedback on latency/cost is great.

We9d like to explore a promotional package for the cohort: 10 startups, each receiving a small pool of inference credits and a 3-month trial extension that can be used for private deployments/early testing. Ballpark usage per company is ~100-200k tokens over the trial.

What would Redwood need to qualify the cohort and approve a promotional credit grant? We9re flexible on terms — happy to sign a simple promo addendum or complete a short form.

Attaching the application PDF for the cohort (SeedVault_Accelerator_Application.pdf).

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Gupta
Founder & CEO, SeedVault
samir@seedvault.io
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@seedvault.io>
Cc: Jane Morales <jane@seedvault.io>
Date: Wed, 5 Nov 2025 09:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Spark accelerator — request for cohort credits

Hi Samir — great to hear and thanks for the application PDF.

Short answer: we can do a cohort promo for accelerators. To move quickly, can you confirm the following so we can scope approvals:
- Confirm the 10 companies are pre-accepted to the Jan cohort (or provide expected acceptance date).
- Expected average monthly token usage per company during the 3-month period (rough estimate is fine).
- Any special data residency or private deployment requirements for cohort companies.

If that looks good I9ll loop in Lauren for approval of a promo credit pool and finalize terms (credit amounts, expiry, and any reporting obligations). We typically issue credits as a single promo code per company or via an account allocation for the SeedVault admin to distribute.

Proposed starter: $7k of platform credits total (split across the 10 companies) + 3-month extended trial for any company that signs by Jan 10. Credits to expire 6 months after activation. I9ll confirm with ops/legal.

Can you send the accepted-company list (or a link to the cohort roster) and confirm you9re fine with the proposed structure?

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Nov 2025 09:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Spark accelerator — request for cohort credits (internal approval)

Lauren / Aditya,

Forwarding Samir9s request — SeedVault wants credits for 10 companies (Jan cohort). I proposed $7k pool + 3-month trial extension, credits expire 6 months after activation. They provided the accelerator application PDF (attached to their original email).

Why I9m recommending approval:
- SeedVault is a high-signal partner; we9ve had positive perf signals from two pilot companies.
- The PR/partner motion could drive >$5k ARR within 6 months if even 2–3 companies convert.
- This is a low-risk promotional play; administrative overhead is small (single promo allocations).

Request: Please approve a one-time promotional credit allocation (RDW-4521) of $7,000 and permission to require a simple promo addendum or sign-off from SeedVault. If approved I9ll ask legal to prepare a short DocuSign and ops to stage the promo codes.

Notes: If you9d prefer smaller amount I can reduce to $4k and prioritize companies with clear pilots.

Thanks,
Stephanie
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 6 Nov 2025 11:00:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Spark accelerator — request for cohort credits (internal approval)

Approve — conditional.

Approved amount: $7,000 total (deal RDW-4521). Conditions:
- Promo addendum (basic terms) to be signed by SeedVault (I9ve attached suggested language in promo_terms_v2.docx).
- SeedVault must submit the final accepted-company roster at least 7 days before activation.
- Credits will be issued as ten allocations (one per company) and will expire 6 months after activation.
- Marketing/partner team to be looped for co-marketing approval; don9t promise PR without partner brief.

Once legal confirms the addendum is good, ops can create the promo allocations and provide an activation timeline.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Samir Gupta <samir@seedvault.io>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jane Morales <jane@seedvault.io>
Date: Fri, 7 Nov 2025 08:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Spark accelerator — request for cohort credits

Thanks Stephanie — this works for us. Attached is the finalized cohort application PDF (SeedVault_Accelerator_Application.pdf) and the roster link (we9ve also sent a DocuSign to the address you9ll get from legal): https://docusign.com/seedvault-rdw-promo

We agree to the conditions in Lauren9s note and will provide the final 10-company roster by Dec 31. Please confirm next steps and when we can expect the DocuSign link to be active.

Appreciate the help — excited to get the cohort onboarded on Redwood.

Best,
Samir
Founder & CEO, SeedVault
